- Remove `.github/CODEOWNERS` L43 `/skills/` and L53 `/ui/skills/` once the #33717 weekly audit workflow is live; reviewer requests on skills PRs are then the relay's per-PR plan (#33540). The PR also changes the queue guard's `codeownersMirrorVerdict` and its self-test (it reds when a Tier H row has no CODEOWNERS line). Tier H; the maintainer merges.
- From the evaluation (not the ruling): derive the mirror exemption from the register (rows carrying a per-PR arm), not a hand-kept list; the `workflows` row has the same mismatch and gets its own card.

Held until #33717's workflow is live. Cite as Ruling-ref.
